activity_summary: Home, you felt the company drop back into its six-day gear. You counted the day as fifty-two shillings, fourteen lines, five men back on ten shillings, and an oath that sounded long. You did not begin the letter.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the gear, the count and the letter, and stopped.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Mentioned in The wheel took the water

facets.activity: Felt the company drop back into its six-day gear

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Walking home, the wheel took the water
